name: @rei/cedar-token-video
description: Remotion video: web-token palettes filtered and rebuilt as the Cedar semantic color structure

scripts.dev: npm run build:data && npm run fonts && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run build:data && npm run fonts && remotion render src/index.ts TokenFilter out/token-filter.mp4
scripts.still: npm run build:data && npm run fonts && remotion still src/index.ts TokenFilter out/token-filter.png --frame=500
scripts.compositions: npm run build:data && npm run fonts && remotion compositions src/index.ts
